package.name: racer_session_tools
package.description: Offline measurement tools for the car session (brief 34, pre-registration PnP v0.3 section 5). limiter_whatif_cli replays a recorded /drive_raw stream through racer_safety's UNCHANGED gate code (compiled read only from the sibling package, nothing in racer_safety is edited or linked) once with the recorded per-cycle dt and once with the nominal period, and prints the safety events the gate would have raised. ROS-free at run time, publishes nothing, drives nothing. tools/pnp_session_report.py drives it.
